one_line: Static and serverless hosting platform with a REST API for atomic deploys, forms, DNS, env vars and site management.
auth_notes: OAuth2 for public integrations (app registration in user settings, authorize endpoint app.netlify.com/authorize); personal access tokens (PATs) for scripts; 'Authorization: Bearer' header; SAML teams need explicit token grant
self_serve_notes: Free tier; PAT generation is self-serve in user settings (Applications > Personal access tokens); OAuth apps registered self-serve

api_surface.breadth_estimate: REST API at api.netlify.com/api/v1 covering sites, deploys (digest/ZIP), forms/submissions, env vars, snippets, DNS, hooks; OpenAPI reference published
api_surface.webhook_note: Hooks API triggers webhooks/email/Slack on events like submission_created, deploy_created, deploy_failed

existing_mcp.note: No official MCP server confirmed; community MCP servers exist (knowledge); official Go and JS API clients documented

evidence.note: fetched text confirms OAuth2/PAT auth, REST endpoints, hooks/webhooks, rate limits and OpenAPI

agent_notes: Well-documented; note password resets invalidate PATs.
